subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should the Telegram message tool expose irreversible forum-topic deletion, and if so what explicit authorization or confirmation contract must distinguish it from ordinary message deletion?
rationale: Telegram topic deletion is materially more destructive than close/reopen and runs through an agent-facing capability when the bot has can_manage_topics permission; source evidence does not establish a previously approved safety contract.

options.title: Approve explicit lifecycle actions
options.body: Add distinct close, reopen, and delete topic actions, with deletion governed by a maintainer-approved destructive-operation contract rather than overloading ordinary message delete.

options.title: Ship reversible operations first
options.body: Land close and reopen on the existing Telegram action seam, and retain deletion as a separate follow-up until its authorization semantics are agreed.

options.title: Keep topic management out of the message tool
options.body: Retain create/edit only and direct broader administrative automation to a separately designed plugin capability.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add distinct close, reopen, and delete topic actions, with deletion governed by a maintainer-approved destructive-operation contract rather than overloading ordinary message delete.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared Telegram action and runtime seam is most strongly associated with this contributor in the available feature history.
